author: MiniWarGaming

The Green Tide goes to war again in today's clash against the very noble, and fierce defenders of the Imperium of Mankind, the Imperial Knights! 

Josh and Luka throw down some proper 10th Edition Matched play while testing out some new lists in this 2,000 point Battle Report.
